author: host
explanation: Uniform centre-entry stamping. Detect3x3rings and coloured centres; locate each matching unique solid bar. Step the entire motif by3cells along the visible centre-to-bar axis. Stamp the first copy whose CENTRE is inside the bar, then stop, even if its border crosses the far edge. Invalid diagonal, jump-over, off-grid or colliding scenes reject. NumPy target uses components and patch writes; independent gate subtracts tile-centre coordinates from per-colour cell sets, identifies rectangles and simulates a coordinate canvas. Only BG=palette[8] is specialised.
constructor_review: Matches unchanged native draw(). Archived far-edge guard is a solver defect that stops the tile before it reaches a thin bar. Fixtures are aligned; native samples additionally contain offsets1and2. Tests preserve both overshoot cases and no aligned-only restriction is imposed.
limitations: Declared intended mechanism is centre-entry. Aligned fixture demos alone do not refute every alternative stop convention; this limitation is explicit. Requires the native exclusive frame colour, unique solid bar per centre colour and noncolliding paths. No query-label access.
sampling: Native joint rejection is slow. Audit uses distribution-equivalent compiled rejection proposals followed by unchanged native explicit rendering, plus4 untouched native-RNG samples. Proposal laws, acceptance parity, source hashes, rejection attempts and entry-offset histogram are retained. Native generator source unchanged.
validation: Six tests passed: fixtures acrossD4/palette; thin-bar overshoot and thick offset2; query-label poisoning; reject archived wrong-stop demo; reject diagonal/jumped-bar inputs; D4-argument independence.1000sample audit recorded separately.
